history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A photo booth strip featuring two young Asian women posing playfully against a white, slightly textured curtain backdrop. The overall aesthetic is reminiscent of a vintage Instax film strip, complete with the characteristic borders and slight imperfections.

In the top left panel, one woman with long, dark hair and glasses rests her hand on the head of the other woman, who has lighter brown hair and is puckering her lips. The woman with glasses is wearing a black t-shirt, and the other has on a leopard-print top.

The middle panel shows the two women from the chest up. The woman on the left, in the leopard-print top, is pointing her finger towards the woman on the right. The woman on the right, in a black t-shirt and glasses, smiles at the camera. Their expressions are lively and engaging.

The top right panel features the same two women, with the woman on the left winking and the woman on the right smiling with her eyes closed, wearing glasses.

The bottom left panel shows the two women from the chest up, both wearing leopard-print tops. They are posing closely together, with both of them making peace signs with their fingers near their eyes. They have gentle smiles.

The bottom right panel shows the two women from the chest up, both in black tops. They are making peace signs with their fingers near their eyes and smiling softly. The woman on the left has brown hair, and the woman on the right has darker hair and glasses.

The lighting is soft and diffused, typical of a photo booth, creating a gentle illumination that highlights their features without harsh shadows. The color palette is dominated by the muted tones of their clothing and hair against the neutral white background, with the warm tones of their skin and the slight yellow cast of the Instax film adding to the vintage feel. The mood is cheerful, youthful, and intimate, capturing a moment of friendship and fun. The image has a slight grainy texture and the characteristic light leaks or imperfections of instant film.
